behaviors_asserted: When app.onError is registered, compose currently catches errors at the inner dispatch and routes them to onError before the await unwinds
Add an optional argument to next: NextOptions with a rethrow boolean to control error propagation
When { rethrow: true } is passed, the dispatch lets the error propagate out of await next() so the caller can try/catch it
Calling next() with no argument (the default) behaves exactly as today
